newsitem.title: USA: ITT shrs off sharply after results warning.
newsitem.headline: ITT shrs off sharply after results warning.

text.p: ITT Corp shares were under seige on Tuesday after the company warned that third quarter results will be below forecasts because of gaming revenue shortfalls, particularly at its Las Vegas operations.
The selloff pushed ITT to the top of the New York Stock Exchange percentage losers list in blistering activity.
Just ahead of midday, the shares were off 8, or almost 15 percent, to 48, a level not seen since January.
ITT was the second most active issue on the NYSE, with more than 5.1 million shares traded, swamping the stock's average daily volume of about 465,000 shares.
Investor apprehension was further heightened by a series of brokerage downgrades and analysts' earnings estimate cuts.
After the market close Monday, ITT said third quarter results were expected to be about flat with the year-ago $0.56 per share.
It said that last month, revenues from the premium play business -- specifically baccarat -- were "significantly below August 1995 almost exclusively in Las Vegas."
Also, construction delays in the North Casino at Caesars Palace, and continued construction-related disruption at the Desert Inn will also hurt the quarter, it said.
